rationale: The candidate gives the correct supported mechanism. command.go:1183–1198 says the default help flag is added only if no "help" flag exists and shows that the default combines the long name and shorthand via BoolP("help", "h", ...). command.go:883–886 explicitly says initialization is delayed to allow user overriding. command.go:894–905 reads only the boolean flag named "help" and returns flag.ErrHelp when true. These preserved bytes support both the default indistinguishability and the proposed separation: predefine "help" without shorthand and register "h" independently.
